title: CRM hygiene and forecast review
lesson: Confirm required fields and distinguish unavailable pipeline value from zero. Apply consistent win-rate scope.

questions.prompt: Open deal amounts are missing. What should the forecast show?
choices: Open deal count and an unavailable value
questions.explanation: Unknown monetary value must remain unavailable.
Open deals are excluded from closed-deal conversion.

title: Engagement review and customer handoff
lesson: Normalize Gong/Apollo exports, link activities to known opportunities and capture explicit next steps.

questions.prompt: An exported call has an unknown CRM opportunity ID. What next?
choices: Count it as a won deal
questions.explanation: Unknown relationships must be reviewed before import.

questions.prompt: What establishes a native Gong connection?
questions.explanation: Export review does not establish native platform access.

title: Migration, automation and commission controls
lesson: Reconcile migrations, prevent conflicting retries and review scenario commissions before any external finance process.

questions.prompt: The same event ID arrives with a different amount. What happens?
questions.explanation: Stable IDs cannot silently refer to changed payloads.

choices: A scenario review was completed; no money moved
questions.explanation: This app has no payment connector.
